_doc: Level-owned lines for Nova Plaza (bs.nova.*), same shape as scrapheap_lines.json (id -> who/text/kind). LevelKit.register_lines merges them into VOManager at level load; the lead adds bs/levels/nova_plaza_lines to VOManager.LINE_SOURCES. Original lines (st.nova*, cs.nova*, q.q4*, memo.16-20/38, code.*) stay in the story data and are referenced by id.

NOVA PLAZA

THE CONSUMPTION ZONE™
NOW CLOSED FOR SHOPPING

bs.nova.ad_finetree_live.text:
FINETREE™ LIVE
NEW FINE ISSUED: BOLT
UNAUTHORIZED HEROISM (2ND OFFENSE)

bs.nova.ad_hoa_fines.text: THIS MONTH'S MOST FINED HOME: ALL OF THEM

bs.nova.fine_06.text: LATE FEE ON A LATE FEE · 77

bs.nova.obj_stamps.text: Get an HOA Variance (HOA District, west) and a Permit to Approach (Permit Office, east)

bs.nova.obj_train.text: Ride the Nova Loop from the Civic Center station to the FineTree

bs.nova.obj_core.text: Grab the Keystone Core behind the server wall

bs.nova.obj_exit.text: Back to the landing pad: the Return Relay is lit

bs.nova.contravention_sub.text: A variance has been printed at the clubhouse counter

bs.nova.stamps_sub.text: The Nova Loop will now carry you

bs.nova.rewards_sub.text: 120 bolts for the last resident standing

bs.nova.cushion_sub.text: The Squatter will be insufferable about this

bs.nova.tow_sub.text: GLAMBOT Pop-Up Segment: survive five waves

bs.nova.hint_walkway.text: Moving walkways carry you along their arrows. Stand still and enjoy the ride.

bs.nova.hint_violation.text: COMPLIANCE EYE! Sprinting, jumping on a walkway or fighting inside its yellow cone reverses every walkway in the district. Throw the mallet at an Eye to blind it for 20 s.

bs.nova.hint_rules.text: Clubhouse rules: NO RUNNING, NO HORSEPLAY, NO JUMPING ON THE LAWN. Break all three in front of the three Eyes to be issued a variance.

bs.nova.hint_hall.text: The take-a-number hall: ride the walkways to the counter. They reverse whenever an Eye logs a violation.

bs.nova.hint_train.text: Both stamps! Board the Nova Loop at the Civic Center station, up the long ramp.

bs.nova.hint_plaza.text: Feed the Algorithm paperwork: punt the complaint canisters into the intake slots on its wall.

bs.nova.hint_updraft.text: A ventilation updraft! Jump in and ride it up.

bs.nova.hint_lamps.text: Smart lamp posts carry orange anchor rings: Tether-Hook points.

bs.nova.train_locked.text: NOW BOARDING: RESIDENTS HOLDING AN HOA VARIANCE AND A PERMIT TO APPROACH. CURRENT ELIGIBLE RESIDENTS: ZERO.

bs.nova.ticket_taken.text: YOUR NUMBER IS 4,051,227. NOW SERVING: 0. PLEASE ENJOY THE WALKWAYS.

bs.nova.ticket_again.text: You already have a number, Bolt. It's very large. Treasure it.

bs.nova.counter_permit.text: NOW SERVING: 4,051,227. CONGRATULATIONS. YOU MAY APPROACH. DO NOT APPROACH TOO CLOSELY.

bs.nova.counter_done.text: YOUR PERMIT IS VALID. YOUR PERMIT IS BEING WATCHED.

bs.nova.variance_line.text: We broke every rule they had and they gave us paperwork for it. I love bureaucracy. I hate that I love it.

bs.nova.contravention_line.text: RESIDENT FOUND IN CONTRAVENTION. A VARIANCE HAS BEEN ISSUED. THANK YOU FOR YOUR NONCOMPLIANCE.

bs.nova.stamps_line.text: A variance AND a permit. Bolt, we're the first legal residents Nova Plaza's had in years. The monorail's ours.

bs.nova.pa_violation_sprint.text: VIOLATION LOGGED: RUNNING. WALKWAYS WILL NOW REVERSE FOR YOUR CONVENIENCE.

bs.nova.pa_violation_walkway_jump.text: VIOLATION LOGGED: JUMPING ON A WALKWAY. MOVING FLOORS ARE FOR STANDING.

bs.nova.pa_violation_fight.text: VIOLATION LOGGED: HORSEPLAY. PLEASE BE VIOLENT QUIETLY.

bs.nova.pa_violation_jump.text: VIOLATION LOGGED: JUMPING. THE GROUND IS THERE FOR A REASON.

bs.nova.pa_rule_run.text: RULE 1 VIOLATED: NO RUNNING. YOU ARE ONE STEP CLOSER TO A VARIANCE.

bs.nova.pa_rule_horseplay.text: RULE 2 VIOLATED: NO HORSEPLAY. NOTED. FILED. ADMIRED.

bs.nova.pa_rule_lawn.text: RULE 3 VIOLATED: NO JUMPING ON THE LAWN. THE LAWN HAS BEEN INFORMED.

bs.nova.underpass_01.text: "I had a house. Then I had a fine for the house. Now I just have the fine."

bs.nova.underpass_02.text: "The soup line's been empty since the soup got a parking ticket."

bs.nova.underpass_03.text: "They fined me for sleeping under the highway. Then they fined me for the highway."

bs.nova.underpass_04.text: "Cardboard's still free. The HOA has formed a committee about that."

bs.nova.qhint_q4a.text: Hear that whirring? Ticket printers. A Meter Maid's close, and she's already writing.

bs.nova.qhint_q4b.text: Water gurgling in a pipe. One of the Squatter's fountain chips is around here.
